= Enter a device passcode on iOS
:navtitle: Enter a device passcode on iOS

// Source: KOB-53003 (Jira release-note field). Draft generated by Robot Ranch for docs-team review.

Enter the device passcode on the iOS system passcode screen during a manual session. iOS hides the on-screen keypad on this screen from the session video stream. The system passcode screen appears in these flows:

* Apple Pay
* Wallet *Add Card*
* Hidden apps folder

== Requirements

* Your organization has passcode (PIN) mode enabled.
* The device has a passcode set.

Devices that meet both requirements show as *Supported* for xref:devices:device-metadata.adoc#_passcode[passcode] on the *Devices* page.

// REVIEWER NOTE: The Jira source states the Supported criteria for the Passcode filter and device-list icon.
// Confirm with the SME that the same criteria gate the keypad overlay and Auto-fill passcode in a session,
// and whether the feature is limited to Private and Local devices, as the Apple Pay page states.

== Find a device that supports passcode entry

. Select *Devices*.
. In the search bar, filter by *Passcode* and choose *Supported*.
+
A passcode icon appears next to the device name in card view and list view. Hover over the icon to show *Passcode enabled - required for Apple Pay*.
. xref:manual-testing:start-a-manual-session.adoc[Start a manual session] on the device.

== Enter the passcode

. On the device, open the flow that requests the device passcode.
+
When the passcode screen is detected, a numeric keypad overlay appears on the session stream.
. Enter the passcode by using one of these methods:
** Tap the digits on the keypad overlay.
** Select *Passcode helper* on the session toolbar, then select *Auto-fill passcode* to enter the device's configured passcode.

// REVIEWER NOTE: Confirm whether *Auto-fill passcode* also appears on the keypad overlay itself,
// or only in the *Passcode helper* menu. Add screenshots of the overlay and the Passcode helper menu.

== Show or hide the keypad overlay

To show the keypad overlay when it does not appear automatically, or to hide it, select *Passcode helper* on the session toolbar and choose the show or hide option.

// REVIEWER NOTE: Confirm the exact labels of the show and hide options in the Passcode helper menu.
